title: SPARC Pig1 Acute Wired ColoMOCA Implantation
author: Dennis Bourbeau
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfxbjpin

steps.title: Anesthesia Preparation
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the pig and establish maintenance and access.

substeps.instruction: Administer an intramuscular dose of telazol (4.4−6.6 mg/kg).
Intubate orotracheally and maintain on isoflurane in oxygen (1-5%, depending on anesthetic depth).
Monitor anesthetic depth via response to stimulus, heart rate, respiratory rate, and eye position.
Place a peripheral catheter in an auricular vein for fluid administration.
Administer buprenorphine IM or IV (0.02−0.1 mg/kg) if needed.

steps.title: Surgical Preparation
steps.instruction: Position the animal and prepare the bladder.

substeps.instruction: Place the pig in a supine position.
Insert a 10F Dover catheter (Covidien; Catalog # 8887603101) using a guidewire and tape it to the side of the pig to reduce bladder pressure on the colon.

steps.title: Calibrate Manometry Catheter
steps.instruction: Calibrate the air-charged Laborie T-DOC anorectal manometry catheter on the benchtop.

steps.title: Clear Rectum
steps.instruction: Insert a speculum (anoscope) approximately 10 cm into the rectum and remove stool via manual disimpaction.

steps.title: Implant ColoMOCA
steps.instruction: Insert and secure the ColoMOCA device in the rectum.

substeps.instruction: Insert the ColoMOCA into the rectum through an anoscope using a Boston Scientific Resolution Clip mucosal tool.
Place the clip around the handle/loop of the ColoMOCA and deploy the clip to attach the device to the rectal mucosa.

steps.title: Verify Signal and Pressure Response
steps.instruction: Confirm wireless signal and pressure sensitivity of the ColoMOCA.

substeps.instruction: Verify that the chataMOCA receiving coil is transmitting data to the laptop via Labview software.
Press down on the lower abdomen (2-3 seconds) where the ColoMOCA is attached and confirm pressure response.
Remove the anoscope and press the lower abdomen again to confirm pressure response.

steps.title: Reference Pressure Calibration
steps.instruction: Use the T-DOC balloon catheter to establish reference pressure and bowel compliance.

substeps.instruction: Insert the T-DOC balloon catheter and add 10 ml water to the large balloon.
Record pressure as a function of volume infused to calculate bowel compliance.
Press on the lower abdomen multiple times (waiting ~30 seconds between presses) and record both balloon and ColoMOCA pressure.

steps.title: Conductivity and Stool Testing
steps.instruction: Test the ColoMOCA electrodes and pressure sensors using real and artificial stool.

substeps.instruction: Insert an anoscope and introduce real stool onto the ColoMOCA.
Press on the abdomen multiple times (2-3 seconds each) and record pressure and electrode data.
Remove real stool, press on the abdomen multiple times (2-3 seconds each), and record data.
Insert artificial stool onto the ColoMOCA.
Press on the abdomen multiple times (2-3 seconds each) and record pressure and electrode data.
Remove artificial stool, press on the abdomen multiple times (2-3 seconds each), and record data.

steps.title: Sensor Orientation Testing
steps.instruction: Evaluate pressure response based on sensor rotation.

substeps.instruction: Twist/rotate the sensor so pressure sensors face the bowel wall proximal to the abdomen; press abdomen multiple times (2-3 seconds each) and record data.
Rotate the sensor so pressure sensors face away from the abdominal pressure; press abdomen multiple times (2-3 seconds each) and record data.

steps.title: Final Measurements and Data Collection
steps.instruction: Perform final pressure and anatomical measurements.

substeps.instruction: Insert the balloon catheter approximately 2 cm into the rectum and inflate with 10 ml water.
Measure the size (diameter and length) of the stools, and the dimensions (diameters and lengths) of the colon, rectum, and anus.
Measure colon and stool thickness and impedances.
Press on the abdomen multiple times (2-3 seconds each) and record pressure data from both the ColoMOCA and balloon catheter.
Rotate the sensor to face the bowel wall proximal to the abdomen, press the abdomen multiple times (2-3 seconds each), and record data from both devices.

steps.title: Device Removal
steps.instruction: Remove the balloon catheter and the ColoMOCA device.
